title: Wawaila wawaila kehte the sarwar wawaila
body:
mashk o alam haato'n me liye, sar ko jhukaye rote huwe
kehte huwe khaime me aaye sibte payamber wawaila
wawaila wawaila kehte the sarwar wawaila
saani-e-hyder tha wo jari
qalb ki quwwat tha wo jari
chord sidhaare mujhko tanha ibne hyder wawaila
nehr pe tha ek hashr bapa
jinn o malak karte the buka
kehte the sar ko peet ke sarwar ibne hyder wawaila
shaane huwe dariya pe qalam
doobe lahu me mashk o alam
sogaya dariya par pyasa shere ghazamfar wawaila
fouje yazeedi sojayegi
sona sakenge ahle haram
lash-e-baradar par ye nouha padhte the sarwar wawaila
<<MINI>>
baali sakina pyaasi rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
ashkon se mu dhoti rahi
kehti rahi zainab ro rokar haaye ghazamfar wawaila
baad mere aye jaane baradar
lut jayenge ahle haram
<<DIVIDER>>
chheenega bewo'n ki rida shimr e sitamgar wawaila
teer e sitam ghazi pa chale
pyaase rahe goudi ke pale
bole kamar ko thaam ke ran me sibte payambar wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
bole behen se shahe huda
hogaya humse bhai juda
ab to lutega shaam se pehle mera bhara ghar wawaila
teer e sitam se mashk chhidi
<<MINI>>
baali sakina pyaasi rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
legaya mazher daagh ye saqqa apne dil par wawaila
